title: Do Language Models Understand Morality? Towards a Robust Detection of Moral Content
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) and NLI-based models to detect and classify moral values in text according to the Moral Foundation Theory (MFT). This framework includes dimensions like Care/Harm, Fairness/Cheating, Loyalty/Betrayal, Authority/Subversion, and Purity/Degradation.
